texts.Why are you interested in working at Sun: Suno is generative AI shipped to consumers at scale - exactly where trust & safety stops being a policy document and becomes a production engineering problem. That is the problem I already work on daily: I run a production multi-machine Claude agent fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines) operated in public, and I build guardrails for it - agent-leash, and verbatim-citation-gate, an MIT-licensed gate that catches fabricated RAG citations. My MSc is in computer and information systems security (MEPhI, cryptography), and I spent a decade in adversarial crypto markets (exchange infrastructure, market-maker engines, anti-fraud), so I think about abuse paths before launch, not after. I would love to apply that mix of applied security engineering and hands-on agentic tooling to keeping Suno safe for its creators.
